risk_summary: The excerpt presents generally constructive operating performance and integration benefits from the Brakes Acquisition, supported by several quantified metrics. However, extensive non-GAAP adjustments, estimated calendar-week normalization, acquisition-related exclusions, and market-share methodology caveats complicate comparability and may soften visibility into underlying performance. Competitive pricing pressure, customer-volume declines, deflation, pension withdrawal costs, and execution risk remain notable concerns.
